newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Spot Saudi riyal, interbank deposits unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Spot Saudi riyal, interbank deposits unchanged.

text.p: The spot Saudi riyal was steady against the dollar and riyal interbank deposit rates were mainly unchanged in moderate trade, dealers in Saudi Arabia said.
They said the market was tight in short-dates after a week-long holiday marking the end of Eid al-Adha.
"Riyal rates were mainly unchanged this week," one dealer said. He put spot-next and one-week funds at 5-3/4, 5/8 percent.
One-month interbank deposit rates were quoted at 5-13/16, 11/16 percent, three months at 5-7/8, 3/4 percent, six months at 6-1/16, 5-15/16 percent and one-year at 6-7/16, 5/16 percent.
The spot Saudi riyal was put at 3.7504/06 to the dollar.
